dialogues.speaker: Diotima
dialogues.text: I'm Diotima of Meropis, one of the very first inhabitants here. When I arrived, there were no collections of books, only a desolate wilderness.

dialogues.speaker: Diotima
dialogues.text: Back then, I was a boatman, responsible for sending wandering souls onto the silver shining ships, bound for the Moon Capital above the clouds.

dialogues.speaker: Diotima
dialogues.text: Come to think of it, it's not much different from what I do now.
